hints.title: Retain One Character Type
hints.text: To make all remaining characters equal, choose a target character and delete all occurrences of any other character.

hints.title: Cost Complementarity
hints.text: The deletion cost is total_cost - retained_cost. Minimizing deletion cost is equivalent to maximizing the sum of costs of retained characters.

hints.title: Aggregate by Character
hints.text: Tally the sum of costs for each distinct character appearing in the string.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def minDeletionCost(self, s: str, cost: list[int]) -> int:
        char_costs = defaultdict(int)
        for ch, c in zip(s, cost):
            char_costs[ch] += c
        
        total_cost = sum(cost)
        max_retained = max(char_costs.values())
        return total_cost - max_retained
```

complexity.notes: Here sigma is the alphabet size (at most 26 for lowercase English letters).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating subsets of characters without grouping by character type leads to exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dictionary of character costs uses O(sigma) = O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects recognizing the duality between minimum deletion cost and maximum retained cost.
